findings.highlight: after getting to the lake
findings.evidenceJa: 境内を迂回し、池に辿り着いた
findings.governingReading: after circling around the temple grounds and reaching the pond
findings.explanation: Saber’s route around the grounds disappears.

findings.highlight: fantasy races
findings.evidenceJa: 幻想種
findings.governingReading: Phantasmal Species
findings.explanation: A defined supernatural category becomes generic fantasy taxonomy.

findings.highlight: fought “dragons”
findings.evidenceJa: 剣を合わせた事もある
findings.governingReading: crossed swords even with the Dragon Species
findings.explanation: Saber’s direct sword engagement and the technical species category are weakened.

findings.highlight: She stares at it and shakes her head
findings.evidenceJa: 呆然と肉塊を見据え、咄嗟にかぶりをふった
findings.governingReading: She stares dumbfounded at the mass and reflexively shakes her head
findings.explanation: Saber’s stunned state and immediate defensive reaction disappear.

findings.highlight: Her instincts tell her
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の予知が告げている
findings.governingReading: her precognition warns her
findings.explanation: Saber’s supernatural foreknowledge becomes ordinary instinct.

findings.highlight: cannot touch it
findings.evidenceJa: 触れてはならない
findings.governingReading: must not touch it
findings.explanation: A warning against dangerous contact becomes physical incapacity.

findings.highlight: she hears her Master
findings.evidenceJa: マスターからの命令が届いている
findings.governingReading: a command from her Master is reaching her
findings.explanation: The Servant-Master command relation becomes mere audibility.

findings.highlight: She stops her feet
findings.evidenceJa: 踏みだしかけた足を引き
findings.governingReading: She draws back the foot she had begun to advance
findings.explanation: A reversed step becomes an unnatural static stop.

findings.highlight: glares at the mountain of meat
findings.evidenceJa: 肉塊を凝視する
findings.governingReading: keeps her eyes fixed on the mass of flesh
findings.explanation: Focused observation is assigned hostility.

findings.highlight: Use your Noble Phantasm on this
findings.evidenceJa: 宝具でぶった斬っちゃって
findings.governingReading: cleave this mass apart with your Noble Phantasm
findings.explanation: Rin’s explicit destructive instruction becomes unspecified use.

findings.highlight: The squirms are turning into throbs
findings.evidenceJa: 蠢動は鼓動に変わり
findings.governingReading: Its writhing turns into a heartbeat
findings.explanation: The Grail’s transformation into lifelike cardiac motion becomes awkward plural sensations.

findings.highlight: the mud is spreading ever further
findings.evidenceJa: 吐き出す泥の量は増え続けている
findings.governingReading: the amount of mud it coughs out keeps increasing
findings.explanation: The mass’s active expulsion and growing volume disappear.

findings.highlight: the world’s restraining power
findings.evidenceJa: 抑止力
findings.governingReading: the Counter Force
findings.explanation: A central Fate-system term is replaced by a descriptive near-guess.

findings.highlight: you should be fine if Shirou is alive
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎が無事ならなんとかなる
findings.governingReading: as long as Shirou survives, we can still manage somehow
findings.explanation: Rin’s strategic fallback becomes a prediction about Saber’s welfare.

findings.highlight: I can handle this curse
findings.evidenceJa: 何に変わろうがこのような呪い、蹴散らして
findings.governingReading: Whatever it may turn me into, I will scatter a curse like this
findings.explanation: Saber’s willingness to risk transformation and her forceful destruction of the curse disappear.

findings.highlight: I can’t let the only one who can destroy the Holy Grail die
findings.evidenceJa: むざむざ死なせる訳にはいかない
findings.governingReading: I cannot simply stand by and let the only person capable of destroying the Grail die
findings.explanation: Rin’s refusal to permit a needless, passive death is weakened.

findings.highlight: The island of meat on the other side
findings.evidenceJa: 対岸の肉塊
findings.governingReading: the mass of flesh on the opposite bank
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents an island rather than locating the mass across the pond.

findings.highlight: ripped off the blood vessels and nerves connected to the meat
findings.evidenceJa: 全身に融け込んだ血管やら神経やら、無理矢理引きちぎって
findings.governingReading: forcibly tore loose the blood vessels and nerves that had fused throughout his entire body
findings.explanation: Shinji’s invasive bodily integration with the Grail is reduced to external connections.

findings.highlight: it would be desperate if it gets its heart taken away
findings.evidenceJa: 心臓とられちゃ暴れる
findings.governingReading: of course it would rampage after having its heart taken
findings.explanation: Violent action is replaced by an emotional condition.

findings.highlight: The tentacles are blocking the way
findings.evidenceJa: 触手によって網が張られている
findings.governingReading: a net of tentacles has already been stretched across the route
findings.explanation: The concrete trap geometry disappears.

findings.highlight: took too much of my magical energy without any reserve
findings.evidenceJa: 遠慮なしで人の魔力もってく
findings.governingReading: takes my magical energy without the least restraint
findings.explanation: Rin’s complaint that Shirou draws without holding back becomes a nonsensical lack of reserve.

findings.highlight: But she’s not serious
findings.evidenceJa: そんな文句を言ってみる。もちろん本気ではない。ただ言ってみただけ
findings.governingReading: She tries voicing the complaint—not sincerely, merely for the sake of saying it
findings.explanation: Rin’s deliberate, provisional performance of complaint is flattened.

findings.highlight: they do not have magical energy to be consumed
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女にエサとしての魔力が残っていなかった
findings.governingReading: Rin has no magical energy left to mark her as viable bait
findings.explanation: Rin’s individual depleted mana state is incorrectly assigned to both Rin and Shinji.

findings.highlight: Her nerves are getting further infiltrated with each passing second
findings.evidenceJa: 神経は秒単位で熱に侵されている
findings.governingReading: Heat is invading her nerves second by second
findings.explanation: The destructive agent and burning bodily danger disappear.

findings.highlight: if she falls down onto the meat
findings.evidenceJa: ずぶずぶと音をたてて
findings.governingReading: she will sink wetly into the flesh with a sucking sound
findings.explanation: The physical process by which Rin would be absorbed and made the core disappears.

findings.highlight: The voice coming into her head
findings.evidenceJa: 耳ではなく心に伝えてくる思念
findings.governingReading: the thought transmitted to her heart rather than her ears
findings.explanation: The explicitly nonauditory Servant communication becomes an interior voice.

findings.highlight: literally a heavy rain
findings.evidenceJa: まさに豪雨
findings.governingReading: exactly like a torrential downpour
findings.explanation: A violent simile becomes the claim that the arrows are literally rain.

findings.highlight: the tentacles, the ground
findings.evidenceJa: 肉の触手だろうが網だろうが台地だろうが
findings.governingReading: whether tentacles of flesh, nets, or the fleshy plateau
findings.explanation: The arrow barrage’s destruction of all three obstacles loses the net and turns the living plateau into ordinary ground.

findings.highlight: with all her might, mud splashing around her
findings.evidenceJa: 自分でも呆れるぐらいの底力で、もうぐちゃぐちゃに濡れながら
findings.governingReading: with reserves of strength that amaze even her, soaked into a complete mess
findings.explanation: Rin’s surprising last reserves and drenched condition disappear.

findings.highlight: Her magical energy replies to the yelling voice
findings.evidenceJa: 叫ぶ声を、彼女の魔力が受け止める
findings.governingReading: Her magical energy catches and receives Rin’s cry
findings.explanation: The mana channel receiving Rin’s command becomes an answering agent.

findings.highlight: The mountain of meat is cut in half and breaks down
findings.evidenceJa: 両断され、倒壊していく肉の山
findings.governingReading: The mountain of flesh is bisected and collapses
findings.explanation: Catastrophic structural collapse becomes generic breakdown.

findings.highlight: turns the lake into a flat field
findings.evidenceJa: 池そのものを、真っ平らな荒野へ
findings.governingReading: turns the pond itself into a perfectly flat wasteland
findings.explanation: The holy sword’s devastation is softened into creation of a field.
